name: hud_ui_mgr_objective_update
description: HudUiMgrObjective::Update refreshes objective HUD visibility and dependent layout state from the current objective widget/runtime state.
known_limits: The viewport smoke covers the objective-widget state reached by viewport activation; broader objective-flow behavior remains covered by focused HUD objective targets and should be revisited in the HUD objective class pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x411eb0 validates the objective HUD update path used by HudUiMgr::OnViewportChanged.
The native viewport activation smoke verifies the objective widget state after ActivateHud dispatches through OnViewportChanged and HudUiMgrObjective::Update.
